what: The D5-D6 shared border (A6, 2026-11-20): D5's west border column x 19 = D6's east border column x 109, heights by y (terrain cells, y south from the north-west corner; heights in game units above the stars at 0). The crossing is the Forbidden Zone's border pass at y 64, level 1,700 over y 62-66 (the source's 'Forbidden Zone' sign at Darkside B2(15,15)); north of y 24 is beyond the world rim; the rest a ridge >= 2,100. Both L1 plans match it cell for cell; the decider may move it (both maps move together). Changed by A6 on 2026-11-21 under D-49 Q6: y 106-109 blend to D1's installed corner (see 'corner').

corner.why: D1 is installed and its (109, 19) is 2,176: the last four cells blend to it; south of y 109 (outside both boxes) the column stays at 2,176. D5's south row meets D2's (19, 19) at 2,496: the installed D1 and D2 disagree at the four-map point (2,176 against 2,496); no crossing there.
